definition: A place where a being lives or stays
A dwelling framed as a nesting place
Home evaluated as a protective refuge
A living being’s communicative voice
Spoken language or articulated utterance
A linguistic system, as in qaroshi
Hold someone in deep, durable care
Maintain a personal bond of concern
Experience romantic love for a person
Nurture a familial/kinship bond
Move away or travel from a place
Travel toward a goal where specified
Move about in search of discovery
Move through air by flying
Consume water or other liquid
See visually
Become aware through visual perception
Have reliable knowledge of a proposition
Be acquainted with the referent
Transfer possession of an item to a recipient
Present an item or opportunity to a recipient
Not dangerous in the relevant context
In a good physical/social state
Positive evaluation of a thing
Endearing or charming in appearance/behavior
Having strength or capacity
Friendship or trusted companionship; does not by itself encode family membership, romance or a legal relationship.

definition: Travel or go; a destination takes -gu, origin -de and location -lo, not direct-object -m.

definition: Continue being or staying; location may be marked -lo. Does not entail sleeping or recuperating.

definition: Pause or recuperate; does not entail staying in a specific place or falling asleep.

definition: Move or seek information in an unfamiliar area; not merely travel to an already chosen destination.

definition: See or notice a referent directly, without committing to knowing its identity or truth.
status: normative semantic clarification 24-27; existing spelling retained

definition: Have reliable knowledge or understanding of a proposition/object; not mere belief or hearsay.
status: normative semantic clarification 24-27; existing spelling retained

definition: Take a liquid by drinking; an -m object is normally a liquid, not a solid food.

definition: Consume food; drinking liquids normally takes këmë instead.

definition: Undertake protection of the object; future forms describe intention/expectation and do not prove protection succeeded.

definition: Act to give or present a theme (-m) to a recipient (-tu). Offers may be declined; completed transfer must be made clear in context.

definition: Care for or cherish someone deeply; does not by itself assert romantic or sexual attraction.

definition: Feel romantic love for a person; not interchangeable with chosen-family care.

definition: Express love or care grounded in family or kinship; neither a biological relation nor romantic feeling is automatically implied.

definition: Consciously and freely agree. Silence, a warm resonance, absence of refusal or a request are not consent.

definition: Possess, have access to or hold the object in context; does not necessarily assert legal title.

definition: Process written symbols or text; correct reading does not entail belief, comprehension or agreement.

definition: Produce an inscription or text; does not entail publishing, delivering or sending it.

definition: Apologize by acknowledging an offense; does not automatically mean forgiveness, compensation or restitution.

definition: Die or cease biological life; figurative “end” meanings require explicit framing.
